synopsis: Seiya Tonami is an office worker in his late twenties. His Friday night routine involves relaxing with a drink, alone at his favorite standing bar. But one day, after coming to the rescue of a college girl who was getting unwelcome attention at the bar, he finds himself sitting next to her every week. From small-talk about daily life to lighthearted complaints… Even though it's just casual conversation, it's so nice to have someone beside you, having a laugh together — it's a romantic comedy that makes you look forward to those Friday nights at the bar, where you feel free to get a little tipsy. synopsis: A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items. One dedicated gamer (PN: Zephyrus) finds himself reincarnated as the protagonist of this very game! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero. Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed! (Source: TO Books, translated)
